Title: Лучшие в мире модели ИИ созданы в Китае  --  оценка экспертов США

Summary: 
China is home to the world's best open-source artificial intelligence (AI) models, according to a rating by the American platform LMArena. The top models are Kimi K2, MiniMax M1, Qwen 3, and DeepSeek R1, which outperformed Google's Gemma 3-72B and Meta's Llama 4-Maverick. Kimi K2, developed by the Chinese startup Moonshot AI, is considered 'one of the most impressive' large language models (LLM) due to its humorous and human-like responses. DeepSeek R1-0528, an improved version of the model released by the Hangzhou-based startup DeepSeek, took second place, showcasing its strength in multi-turn dialog and logical tasks. The rating marks a significant milestone in China's AI industry, narrowing the gap with its American counterparts. The release of DeepSeek V3 LLM in December 2024 and DeepSeek R1 in January 2025 has caused a shock in the tech industry, with Jensen Huang, CEO of Nvidia, praising China's progress in open-source AI, calling DeepSeek, Qwen, and Kimi models 'the best open reasoning models in the world today' and 'very advanced'.

Title: Moonshot AI's updated Kimi model offers expanded context window, improved coding

Summary: 
Moonshot AI, an Alibaba‑backed Chinese AI start‑up valued at US$3.3 billion after its latest funding round, announced on Wednesday that it will release an updated version of its Kimi K2 model, named Kimi K2‑0905, to 20 beta testers on Discord. According to a post by Aspen Choong of Moonshot AI’s growth team, the new model will double its context window from 128,000 to 256,000 tokens and improve coding capabilities. It will also retain the creative‑writing strengths of the original Kimi K2‑0711 while offering 'slightly less hallucination', the post said. However, the update will not include reasoning or vision features, even though Moonshot AI had previously indicated plans to add them. The announcement was later edited to remove the model’s name and other details.

Title: Alibaba's Qwen3 and Moonshot's Kimi-K2 crack top 10 AI rankings, closing in on US models

Summary: 
Alibaba Group’s 1‑trillion‑parameter Qwen3‑max‑preview model entered the LMArena text arena leaderboard in sixth place, the highest position for a Chinese model, with a score of 1,428 that places it just behind the leading U.S. models from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google DeepMind. The model was released on Friday and remains proprietary, with a full launch date yet to be announced. Meanwhile, Alibaba‑backed start‑up Moonshot AI’s Kimi‑K2‑0905 model tied for eighth place with seven other models, including DeepSeek R1 and xAI’s Grok 4, marking it as one of the top open‑source models worldwide. Kimi‑K2‑0905, open‑sourced on Friday, has already accumulated more than 4,500 downloads on Hugging Face and received positive user feedback for its affordability and expanded context window. According to Artificial Analysis, the updated Kimi‑K2‑0905 improved by two points over the original K2 model and showed significant gains in agentic capabilities such as advanced coding and customer‑service tasks. The article notes that China’s AI sector has grown rapidly, with the number of AI companies rising to over 5,000 from 1,454 in 2020, roughly one new company every 11 hours, based on data from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

Title: Alibaba's Qwen3 and Moonshot's Kimi-K2 storm into global AI rankings

Summary: 
Alibaba's Qwen3-max-preview and Moonshot's Kimi-K2-0905 entered the LMArena text‑arena leaderboard, ranking sixth and seventh respectively. The models, released on Friday, are the first Chinese open‑ and closed‑source AI systems to break into the top 10, a milestone that contrasts with last year when no Chinese models appeared in the top 10. Qwen3-max-preview is Alibaba's largest AI model to date, and the ranking is based on user feedback where users submit prompts to two anonymous models and vote for the better answer. Alibaba also owns the South China Morning Post.
